description: A dermatophyte infection affecting the groin, commonly called jock itch.

appearance.general: An often asymmetrical scaly eruption in the groin.

warning_signs: Maceration or signs of secondary bacterial or Candida infection warrant medical assessment.
doctor_discussion_points: Discuss whether skin scraping for mycology is needed to confirm the diagnosis.
